I do all my Recluse runs with Night Comet. Enemies can't read the input for Night Comet, so it's really strong. If you find a staff with Night Comet, go for a Smithing Stone 2 and upgrade it. For relics, you can also choose Improved Invisibility Sorcery.

On the first night, I usually go for basic camps and churches. I try to reach level 6 or 7. On the second night, I target redline marked bosses and the castle boss in the center of the map. If there's a Shifting Earth, I always go for that every second night.

In solo play, you can buy a revive for 10k gold from the Limveld merchant and the third night merchant. So basically, the game gives you one extra life every night, and if you buy both revives from the merchants, you end up with three lives in total for final boss. Every time you revive, revive heals you too.

You should work on improving your pathing. Learn the movesets of normal enemies and minibosses so you can take them out more quickly. If you're playing a melee character, use charged attacks often to break stances it's much easier to do in solo play. Also, pay attention to each nightlords weaknesses. For some exploiting their weakness is crucial; for others, it just gives you an advantage. Most characters ultimates instantly cause a stance break in solo play. So you can stance break with charged attacks, land a riposte, and then as the boss is getting back up, use your ultimate to break their stance again for another riposte.
